S  directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures Daily C-482 Petition No. 331 of 2015 Lok Hon'ble J.C.S. Rawat, J. (Retd.)
Adalat Mahesh Chandra Pant, Member Order None is present for the private parties.

No. ....
 Mr. Deepak Bharadwaj, Brief Holder  for the State.
 Perused the office report as well as the  record.
Office has reported that criminal case  no. 32 of 2015, State vs. Joga Singh, under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC has  been decided on 26.08.2019 by learned  C.J.M., Bageshwar.
The print of the judgment  of Joga Singh vs. State
has been taken from  the website.
That copy of the judgment be  kept on record.
Perusal of the record reveals that the  case of the applicant has been decided.
The  applicant's trial is pending before the Trial  Court u/S 120B and 420 IPC.

The Hon'ble  Court vide order dated 15.04.2015 has  directed that in the meantime, it is provided as  an interim measure that the bailable warrants  issued against the applicants shall be kept in  abeyance till the next date of listing.
The said interim order had been  extended time to time and, at last, on  23.06.2023 by a detailed order of the Hon'ble  High Court has extended the interim order.

Thus, it is apparent that the case has not  become infructuous and in the present case,
 the accused-applicants have been charge-  sheeted under Section 120B and 420 IPC.
The petitioners have sought the  quashment of the charge-sheet no. 37-A of  2014 submitted in case crime no. 28 of 2014.
Thus, it would be expedient in the  interest of justice that the notice be issued to  both the parties to appear in person before the  Court.

On the last date, two writ petition nos.
797 of 2014 and 988 of 2014 were connected with this case.
